name: 02351 · Abington, MA
findings: ZIP 02351 (Abington) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02351 (Abington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02351 (Abington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
